checked.claim: The Project manager keeps only the progress cells live; a project made, deleted, moved, sealed or shared elsewhere is not drawn until reopened.
checked.why: Read the whole road. openProjectManager reads allProjects() once and draws the rows from it; wireProjectManager's only live part is keepFresh, whose run writes [data-drpg-progress] cells and nothing else. keepFresh (live.mjs:837-868) calls run(root) on every heard event and has no other redraw; listenFor with no watch.settings hears every drpg.* world setting and daggerheart.Countdowns, so the window is woken by a create or a room change and the run ignores it. A share writes neither setting (tier 2 E36-T4 pins a share and a revoke at cd 0, meta 0), and listenFor hears GM stores only through watch.stores, which this call does not pass. git grep of drpg-window-projects outside the tests finds only its alreadyOpen and classes lines (projects-ui.mjs:682, 702): nothing closes, reopens or rerenders it. The comment at 554-556 says the same. Save's guards (room compared with the open list, rows gone skipped) were read and hold, so the harm is the display and the Edit road (findings 5, 6). Kept at minor, as the other refuters of this audit kept windows drawn once that lose no write.

checked.claim: The edit window's Save writes the trap's armed and firedAt as read when the window opened, so a fire stamped meanwhile is cleared.
checked.why: Read the whole road. startTrigger is read from secretsOf at open (1034); Save builds trigger { ...result.trigger, armed: startTrigger.armed, firedAt: startTrigger.firedAt ?? null } (1249-1253); projectEditChange copies it into meta.trigger whole (projects.mjs:2631); changeStep hands change.meta to setProjectMeta (projects.mjs:1814), which sends trigger, a PROJECT_SECRET_FIELD, to projectSecretStore.patch(..., { whole: true }) with fresh stamps, so it lands over stampFired's later-in-time but earlier-in-queue patchTrigger({ firedAt }) (traps.mjs:359-362). The watcher then passes `if (trigger.firedAt) continue;` (traps.mjs:207) again. Read further than the reader: armed is written back the same way, so a trap armed by its project's completion while the window stood open (armTrap -> patchTrigger({ armed: true }), traps.mjs:394-401) is disarmed by the Save, and a GM's Rearm meanwhile (rearmTrap, 376-382) is undone. No tier-1 or tier-2 test names startTrigger or opens the window across a fire (grep of tests*.mjs).

checked.claim: The project token card on a GM does not hear the GMs' store, so a share or a revoke leaves "Knows it is there" as drawn.
checked.why: The card's keepLive watch (projects-map.mjs:877) names projectMeta, Countdowns, three hooks and three stores, none of them projectSecretStore; listenFor hears a GM store only through watch.stores (live.mjs:345-350) and WORLD_HOOKS are time, Eclipse and phase only (live.mjs:69). A share is shareChange -> { ownership: ownershipMap(), meta: { viewers } } (projects-secrecy.mjs:442-447): viewers is a PROJECT_SECRET_FIELD (111-112), so setProjectMeta writes the store only, and the ownership map is the same, so changeStep's `moved` is false and no Countdowns write follows. Tier 2 E36-T4 pins exactly this (tests-tier2.mjs:81447-81449: "A revoke and a share write no countdown since S17-31", share and revoke at cd 0, meta 0). The other redraw roads were looked for: drpgProjectSightChanged runs sync's projects kind (projects.mjs:1971-1973), whose 'sheets' is clock.mjs refreshSheets, which renders only documents of type character (clock.mjs:946), and the project actor is an npc (projects-map.mjs:159-160); the card does not watch tokens or actors. The second half (a secret project's name, room or condition) holds for a token drag and a condition change, which write the store alone; for a rename through the edit window it rests on whether the same-value projectMeta write of trait and glyph fires updateSetting on v14, which is the reader's own open question in finding 12.

checked.claim: Mislabeled (finding 6, nit): the window's Delete and Save say "1 deleted." and "Projects updated." whatever the step answered.
checked.why: The Delete branch awaits deleteProject and notifies without reading it; deleteProject answers null unless result.removed (projects.mjs:2669-2673), and changeStep answers { result: null } for a countdown that is not there (projects.mjs:1665). Save notifies DRPG.Project.saved after applyProjectChange whatever it returned. The manager's Delete reads the answer (498). The road to it needs a project deleted elsewhere while an edit window or a stale manager row (finding 1) stood open, which is real. The control does what its label says (it deletes when there is something to delete); what is wrong is the toast, so the verdict reads closer to silent-or-false-success than to mislabeled; the severity nit stands either way.
